body:
An opinionated Go framework for building services on bedrock’s process model.
Humus is for HTTP and REST APIs, gRPC services, queue consumers and jobs, with telemetry, health and graceful shutdown built in. Every humus application is a bedrock.App, and its main is func main() { bedrock.Main(app) }.
Humus is being rebuilt Humus is being rebuilt on bedrock’s process model, package by package. The previous code, and the pages that documented it, have been removed: the Builder/Runner code, the YAML configuration, the global telemetry, and the rest, grpc, job, queue and health packages. Each package comes back through its own accepted proposal, and its pages are written here as it lands.
The plan is in the charter, Proposal: humus on the bedrock process model.
Earlier releases, and their package documentation, remain available on pkg.go.dev.
